theme.archetype: LUXURY & TACTICAL EDGE (Dark mode first with warm gold and amber accents)

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: relative before:absolute before:inset-0 before:p-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-[#D4AF37] before:to-transparent before:rounded-xl before:-z-10

key_features: Portfolio & Design Showcase with style filtering (Tattoos, Barber Cuts, Flash Sheets) & pricing estimates
Smart Appointment Scheduling for instant Barber booking (with time slots & buffers) and Custom Tattoo consultation flow
Stripe Deposit & Payment Processing flow with invoice & receipt generation ($50 deposit checkout)
Custom Tattoo Request Pipeline with image upload, placement, size, budget, and admin quote negotiation
Client & Schedule Management Admin Dashboard with calendar views, inquiry approval, session tracking, and aftercare note delivery
Guest booking & tracking + Password login for Artists/Admin

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based testid on all buttons, forms, tabs, inputs, cards
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: APCA and WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, explicit text color on all hover states

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, fully functional React application featuring client portfolio browsing, instant barber booking with stripe deposit simulation, custom tattoo inquiry pipeline with image attachment simulation and quote management, and a robust Admin Dashboard with calendar schedule and aftercare notes delivery.
